headline: Core inflation keeps falling despite overall rebound: Omar Mejía Castelazo
summary: Deputy Governor Omar Mejía Castelazo defended the decision to lower the reference rate, saying core inflation is trending down despite a general rise and that peso weakness will not pass through to prices.
why: Banco de México sets Mexico's benchmark rate, which drives peso yields and the cost of credit across the economy.
original_headline: Inflación subyacente sigue a la baja pese a repunte general: Omar Mejía Castelazo
